name_zh: 墨西哥·拉萨罗·卡德纳斯：石油国有化与土地改革卡德纳斯主义
name_en: Mexico Lazaro Cardenas: Oil Nationalization & Land Reform Cardenismo
description_zh: 拉萨罗·卡德纳斯 (1895-1970) 墨西哥总统 (1934-1940)，1938年石油国有化建立墨西哥石油公司(PEMEX)，大规模土地改革分配埃希多集体用地，奠定墨西哥革命制度化基础。
description_en: Lazaro Cardenas (1895-1970) Mexico President (1934-1940), 1938 oil nationalization established PEMEX, large-scale land reform distributed ejido collective lands, founded Mexican Revolution institutionalization basis.
reason_zh: 卡德纳斯代表墨西哥革命如何通过资源民族化与土地再分配实现制度化，展示了石油主权与农民利益双重合法性如何构建革命政党长期执政基础，其卡德纳斯主义影响拉美资源民族主义至今。
reason_en: Cardenas represents how Mexican Revolution achieved institutionalization through resource nationalization and land redistribution dual legitimacy, demonstrating how oil sovereignty and peasant interests built revolutionary party long-term rule foundation, his Cardenismo influencing Latin American resource nationalism today.
steps_zh: 研究卡德纳斯早年革命将领与卡列斯冲突
分析1938年石油国有化与美英石油公司博弈
探讨埃希多集体土地分配与农民动员
评估1940年交权阿维拉·卡马乔与革命制度党建立
总结石油国有化土地改革卡德纳斯主义对墨西哥政治的永恒定型
steps_en: Study Cardenas early revolutionary general and Calles conflict
Analyze 1938 oil nationalization and US-UK oil companies game
Explore ejido collective land distribution and peasant mobilization
Evaluate 1940 handover Avila Camacho and PRI founding
Summarize oil nationalization land reform Cardenismo eternal shaping of Mexican politics
expected_zh: 掌握资源民族化与土地改革如何双轮驱动革命制度化，理解石油主权作为国家尊严象征的政治威力，评估卡德纳斯主义对委内瑞拉玻利维亚等国资源民族主义的示范。
expected_en: Master how resource nationalization and land reform dual-wheel drive revolutionary institutionalization, grasp oil sovereignty political power as national dignity symbol, evaluate Cardenismo demonstration for Venezuela Bolivia resource nationalism.
case_zh: 1934 总统；1938 石油国有化；1940 交权；1970 逝世。石油国有化土地改革卡德纳斯范式永存。
case_en: 1934 President; 1938 oil nationalization; 1940 handover; 1970 death. Oil nationalization land reform Cardenas paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Oil nationalization; land reform; PRI; resource nationalism
